description: Rank live Spectra yield opportunities across all networks: fixed rates (buy PT, held to maturity), liquidity provision (LP) and curated MetaVaults. Use for questions like 'best fixed yield on USDC', 'stablecoin yields on Base', 'ETH fixed rate for 6 months'. Returns market and MetaVault ids, APYs in percent, TVL, maturity, app links and data-quality flags. Results with thin liquidity or anomalous data are hidden unless include_flagged is true.

asset.description: Asset or symbol fragment, e.g. "USDC", "ETH", "XRP", "EUR", or "stablecoin". Omit for all assets.

chain.description: Network slug or chain id. One of: mainnet, arbitrum, optimism, base, sonic, hemi, avalanche, bsc, katana, flare, hyperevm, monad, sei, stellar.

include_flagged.description: Include thin-liquidity, outlier, expired and exit-only results.

product.description: fixed = Principal Token fixed rate, lp = liquidity provision, vault = MetaVault, all = everything.

name: spectra_find_yields
title: Find Spectra yield opportunities
